author: miami courant
title: Rep. María Elvira Salazar marks National Agriculture Day with tributes; congratulates new DHS secretary
text:
Rep. María Elvira Salazar, U.S. Representative for Florida’s 27th congressional district, marked National Agriculture Day with public messages expressing gratitude to agricultural workers and emphasizing their significance to the nation’s economy and food security.
On March 24, 2026, Salazar posted: . The message was also shared in Spanish shortly after: .
Later that day, Salazar congratulated Senator Markwayne Mullin on his confirmation as Secretary of Homeland Security: “Congratulations to @SenMullin on his confirmation as Secretary of @DHSgov. At a critical moment for our nation’s security and immigration system, his leadership comes at the right time. I look forward to working together to advance practical solutions and deliver results for the” (March 24, 2026).
National Agriculture Day is an annual event recognizing contributions made by those involved in agriculture across the United States. The observance highlights both economic impact and essential role of farmers in national well-being.
Markwayne Mullin’s confirmation as Secretary of Homeland Security comes amid ongoing discussions about border security and immigration policy in Congress.
